{{one source |date=May 2024}}
In algebra, a '''chiral Lie algebra''' is a [[D-module]] on a curve with a certain structure of [[Lie algebra]]. It is related to an [[E n ring|<math>\mathcal{E}_2</math>-algebra]] via the [[Riemann–Hilbert correspondence]].
